note: Where the town stands (docs/briefs/main-street.md). Each entry is a node under the street (its path), placed by TownLayout before anything is built: at = position in metres, facing = degrees turned about the vertical (0 as built: a building's front toward -Z; 180 turned round, its front toward +Z). An entry with 'in' is given in that building's own space and moves with it. Main Street runs along X, west (-X) toward the sunset; north is -Z.
